name: ohmygame
description: An open-source local-first agent for creating and publishing games.
author: WhiteTowerAI

scripts.build: bun run build:host && bun run build:renderer
scripts.build:host: bun run build:packages && bun --bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --import tsx scripts/build-story-web.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/build-multiplayer-sdk.mjs
scripts.build:packages: bun --bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.build.json && node packages/sdk/build.mjs && bun --bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.build.json && bun --bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/games/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:desktop-app: bun run clean:desktop-build && bun run release:notes --output .runtime/release-notes.md && bun run prepare:preinstalled-plugins && bun run prepare:examples && bun run build:host && bun run build:renderer
scripts.dev: bun --bun node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/index.js --kill-others --names daemon,renderer --prefix-colors cyan,green "bun run dev:daemon" "bun run dev:renderer"
scripts.dev:daemon: bun run prepare:preinstalled-plugins && bun run prepare:examples && node --conditions=ohmygame-source --import tsx --watch src/daemon/server.ts --dev
scripts.dev:desktop: bun run prepare:preinstalled-plugins && bun run prepare:examples && bun run build:host && bun --bun node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/index.js --kill-others --names renderer,desktop --prefix-colors green,cyan "bun run dev:renderer" "bun --bun node_modules/electron/cli.js ."
scripts.start:desktop: bun run prepare:preinstalled-plugins && bun run prepare:examples && bun run build:host && bun run build:renderer && bun --bun node_modules/electron/cli.js . --built-renderer
scripts.package:mac:dir: bun run prepare:desktop-runtime darwin-arm64 && bun run build:desktop-app && bun --bun node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac dir --arm64 --publish never --config.mac.notarize=false --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.package:mac: bun run prepare:desktop-runtime darwin-arm64 && bun run build:desktop-app && bun --bun node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac --arm64
scripts.package:win: bun run prepare:desktop-runtime win32-x64 && bun run build:desktop-app && bun --bun node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win nsis --x64
scripts.test:desktop-game: bun run build:host && bun run build:renderer && node scripts/test-web-game-runtime.mjs
scripts.test:game-recording: bun run build:host && bun run build:renderer && node scripts/test-game-recording.mjs
